column1: # Paragon Graphite: indicators copied by hand from The Citizen Lab's reports
# (no machine-readable list exists; checked 2026-10-29 in citizenlab/malware-indicators and
#   R1 "Virtue or Vice? A First Look at Paragon's Proliferating Spyware Operations", 19 March 2025
#   R2 "Graphite Caught: First Forensic Confirmation of Paragon's iOS Mercenary Spyware Finds
# Format: indicator <TAB> strength <TAB> note.  strength: strong = a match is evidence;
# lead = shown as "worth a look" only.
#   awake-wood.io ...): R1 gives them as TLS certificate labels used to fingerprint servers, not
#   as addresses devices look up. Some may be ordinary domains someone else owns.
# - BIGPRETZEL (Android): R1 names it but doesn't publish what it is.
# - Fingerprints P1-P4: for scanning the internet (Censys), not for checking a device.
# Addresses change hands; each note gives the dates the report saw them in use.
